name: No Mercy
source:
After your mother’s affair shatters your family, you take on a new role: not to fix what’s broken, but to claim her for yourself.

Unveil her deepest secrets, subdue her, and make all women in the game yours.

This visual novel has been pulled out from all stores thanks to a petition of [url=https://www.collectiveshout.org/]Collective Shout[/url], a non-profit against the "objectification of women and the sexualisation of girls," for the reason that "it glorifies rape, violence against women and incest."
translation:
当你母亲的外遇破坏了你的家庭后，你承担了一个新的角色：不是去修复破碎的东西，而是将她据为己有。

揭开她最深的秘密，征服她，让游戏中的所有女性都成为你的。

由于[url=https://www.collectiveshout.org/]Collective Shout[/url]的请愿书，这部视觉小说已从所有商店下架，该组织是一个反对“女性物化和女孩性化”的非营利组织，理由是“它美化强奸、针对​​女性的暴力和乱伦”。
